problem.title: Sokoban
problem.summary: Push crates onto their goal squares. Every push rewrites three cells at once, and some positions can never be recovered.

instances.label: Showcase
instances.description: A 9×7 warehouse with walls, two stable crates, and competing legal moves

instances.label: Stress
instances.description: A 10×8 warehouse with three crates and a substantially larger search frontier

strategies.label: Goal-directed A*
strategies.description: A* prioritises states using an admissible crate-to-goal distance bound.

strategies.label: Fewest exchanges
strategies.description: Breadth-first search explores every shorter replay before accepting a solution.

instance.label: Showcase
instance.description: A 9×7 warehouse with walls, two stable crates, and competing legal moves

documents.title: Sokoban · warehouse solved
documents.description: Stable crates travel through a walled warehouse. Every walk and every three-cell push is replayed as an indivisible economic exchange.
